content:
WhatsApp users can now post longer music clips in their Status, with the length cap doubled to 30 seconds. Here are the details.

WhatsApp Status music clip limit extended to 30 seconds

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is rolling out a status update feature that supports music clips up to 30 seconds long.

The status update feature is like WhatsApp's version of Instagram Stories, and previously music-inclusive posts were limited to 15 seconds.

Users can now select up to 30 seconds of a song to share along with a photo, or post a music clip directly as a status update.

Here's how WABetaInfo explains the way to choose the length of a music clip under the new 30-second cap:

As is typical with WhatsApp's server-side rollouts of new features, the new 30-second cap is not yet available to all users. However, WABetaInfo noted that some iOS and Android users have already seen the new length limit. On the iOS side, the site lists WhatsApp version 26.35.72 as the compatible update.
